record.body:
## Description

Add bin/aa as a same-entrypoint alias for adaptive-artifacts and wire it through scripts/sync-plugin.sh / install layout.

## Approach

Mirror bin/adaptive-artifacts to bin/aa (or thin wrapper execing the same tools/artifacts.py). Update scripts/sync-plugin.sh to include aa in the plugin payload. Add a smoke test or assert both bins exist and --help works.
record.subject: aa-bin-alias
